title: Add ShouldIApply to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [ShouldIApply](https://notsointresting.github.io/shouldiapply) to build
- ShouldIApply tells job seekers their real, calibrated odds of passing a job's initial screen — before they waste the effort applying. Paste your resume and a job description. The app sends them to Pol

Fixes #15315

gist.headline: Odds Before the Odyssey
gist.blurb: ShouldIApply has joined the garden: paste in a resume and job description, then get calibrated initial-screen odds before planting hours into an application. A small reality check, delivered before the cover-letter spiral begins.
gist.summary: Added ShouldIApply to the app build, giving job seekers a Pollinations-powered tool that compares a pasted resume and job description to estimate their calibrated odds of passing the initial screening stage.
gist.impact: Users can now check a role’s likely initial-screen fit before investing time in a full application, with the app available through the Pollinations build.
gist.visual_concept: Depict ShouldIApply as a cozy job-search garden: Polli reviews a resume and job-description parchment beside a friendly retro terminal whose screen shows a simple, encouraging odds meter. A few code-plants and blooming flowers turn the intimidating application process into a calm, practical checkpoint; Polli wears tiny librarian glasses and looks knowingly amused.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden-office scene where the cute Polli bee mascot—with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, rounded light-blue translucent wings, and tiny librarian glasses—compares a resume parchment with a job-description parchment beside a chunky CRT terminal showing a gentle lime-green (#ecf874) “FIT CHECK” odds meter; code-plants and small flowers bloom around the desk. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel mint-lavender-peach gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
